response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark FROM per_order), above_first AS (SELECT p.avg_unfilled, p.avg_unfilled - b.benchmark AS excess_first FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_unfilled > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(a.avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled, AVG(a.excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(a.avg_unfilled - b.benchmark) AS avg_excess_second FROM above_first AS a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS b WHERE a.avg_unfilled > b.benchmark;
